export interface BackgroundTaskCommandRequest {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    command: BackgroundTaskCommand;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskCommandResult {
    role: BackgroundTaskCommand["role"];
    output: unknown;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskRow extends BackgroundTask {
    id: string;
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    origin: BackgroundTaskCollection["source"];
}

export interface BackgroundTasksReadResult {
    tasks: BackgroundTaskRow[];
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export declare const MAINLINE_CONTROL_PERMISSION = "mainline:control";

export declare const MAINLINE_PROVIDER_ID = "system.mainline";

export declare const MAINLINE_READ_PERMISSION = "mainline:read";

export interface MainlineIssue {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    title: string;
    code: string;
}

export declare const mainlineActions: {
    tasks: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, BackgroundTasksReadResult>;
    command: ActionDefinition<BackgroundTaskCommandRequest, BackgroundTaskCommandResult>;
};
